import{jsx as _jsx}from"react/jsx-runtime";import{useEffect,useRef,useState}from"react";import{addPropertyControls,ControlType,useIsStaticRenderer}from"framer";// ---------- Threshold matrices (ordered multi-level dither) ----------
const BAYER4=[0,8,2,10,12,4,14,6,3,11,1,9,15,7,13,5].map(v=>(v+.5)/16);const BAYER8=[0,32,8,40,2,34,10,42,48,16,56,24,50,18,58,26,12,44,4,36,14,46,6,38,60,28,52,20,62,30,54,22,3,35,11,43,1,33,9,41,51,19,59,27,49,17,57,25,15,47,7,39,13,45,5,37,63,31,55,23,61,29,53,21].map(v=>(v+.5)/64);const disc=r=>(u,v)=>u*u+v*v<r*r;const ring=(r,w)=>(u,v,t)=>{const d=Math.sqrt(u*u+v*v);return Math.abs(d-r)<Math.max(w,t);};const plus=(len,w=0)=>(u,v,t)=>{const h=Math.max(w,t);return Math.abs(u)<h&&Math.abs(v)<len||Math.abs(v)<h&&Math.abs(u)<len;};const cross=(len,w=0)=>(u,v,t)=>{const h=Math.max(w,t)*1.4;return Math.abs(u)<len&&Math.abs(v)<len&&(Math.abs(u-v)<h||Math.abs(u+v)<h);};const diamond=r=>(u,v)=>Math.abs(u)+Math.abs(v)<r;const square=r=>(u,v)=>Math.abs(u)<r&&Math.abs(v)<r;const hollowSquare=r=>(u,v,t)=>Math.max(Math.abs(u),Math.abs(v))<r&&Math.max(Math.abs(u),Math.abs(v))>r-Math.max(.2,t*2);const diagonal=w=>(u,v,t)=>Math.abs(u+v)<Math.max(w,t);const either=(...s)=>(u,v,t)=>s.some(f=>f(u,v,t));// Ink glyph sets, lightest to darkest (level 0 = empty cell)
const INK_SETS={mixed:[disc(.26),plus(.6),cross(.6),ring(.58,.12),diamond(.95),square(.8)],circles:[disc(.2),disc(.34),disc(.48),disc(.62),disc(.76),disc(.92)],lines:[diagonal(.1),diagonal(.22),diagonal(.36),diagonal(.52),diagonal(.7),diagonal(.95)],crosses:[plus(.3),plus(.55),plus(.8),plus(.85,.2),plus(.9,.34),plus(.95,.5)]};// Trail glyph sets, faint to strong
const TRAIL_SETS={beads:[disc(.22),ring(.5,.12),disc(.6),disc(.85)],stars:[disc(.2),plus(.55),either(plus(.75),cross(.6)),either(plus(.9,.14),cross(.75,.1))],frames:[square(.2),hollowSquare(.55),hollowSquare(.85),either(hollowSquare(.9),square(.4))]};function buildMasks(shapes,cell){const t=1.1/cell;return shapes.map(shape=>{const m=new Uint8Array(cell*cell);for(let y=0;y<cell;y++){const v=(y+.5)/cell*2-1;for(let x=0;x<cell;x++){const u=(x+.5)/cell*2-1;m[y*cell+x]=shape(u,v,t)?1:0;}}return m;});}// ---------- Color helpers ----------
let colorCtx=null;function toPacked(color,fallback){if(typeof document==="undefined")return 4278190080;if(!colorCtx){const c=document.createElement("canvas");c.width=1;c.height=1;colorCtx=c.getContext("2d",{willReadFrequently:true});}const ctx=colorCtx;if(!ctx)return 4278190080;let value=color||fallback;// Framer color tokens arrive as var(--token, #hex): use the fallback inside
const varMatch=/^var\([^,]+,\s*(.+)\)$/.exec(value.trim());if(varMatch)value=varMatch[1];ctx.clearRect(0,0,1,1);ctx.fillStyle=fallback;ctx.fillStyle=value;ctx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);const[r,g,b,a]=ctx.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data;return(a<<24|b<<16|g<<8|r)>>>0;}function clamp01(v){return v<0?0:v>1?1:v;}/**
 * @framerDisableUnlink
 *
 * @framerIntrinsicWidth 800
 * @framerIntrinsicHeight 600
 *
 * @framerSupportedLayoutWidth fixed
 * @framerSupportedLayoutHeight fixed
 */export default function GlyphTrail(props){const{image,cellSize,glyphs,colors,pattern,tone,trail,speed}=props;const isStatic=useIsStaticRenderer();const rootRef=useRef(null);const canvasRef=useRef(null);// Live settings the loop reads without restarting (keeps the trail alive)
const live=useRef({trail,speed});live.current={trail,speed};const hasImage=image!==undefined&&image!==null&&typeof image==="object"&&typeof image.src==="string"&&image.src.length>0;const src=hasImage?image.src:null;const[imgEl,setImgEl]=useState(null);useEffect(()=>{if(!src){setImgEl(null);return;}let mounted=true;const img=new Image;img.crossOrigin="anonymous";img.onload=()=>mounted&&setImgEl(img);img.onerror=()=>mounted&&setImgEl(null);img.src=src;return()=>{mounted=false;};},[src]);const bg=colors?.background??"#FFFFFF";const ink=colors?.ink??"#1A1A1A";const trailCol=colors?.trail??"#5EB8F2";const contrast=tone?.contrast??1;const brightness=tone?.brightness??0;const invert=tone?.invert??false;const trailShape=trail?.shape??"beads";const drifting=(speed??1)>0;useEffect(()=>{const root=rootRef.current;const canvas=canvasRef.current;if(!root||!canvas)return;const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");if(!ctx)return;const cell=Math.max(4,Math.round(cellSize||10));const matrix=pattern==="4"?BAYER4:BAYER8;const mSize=pattern==="4"?4:8;const mMask=mSize-1;const half=mSize>>1;const BG=toPacked(bg,"#FFFFFF");const INK=toPacked(ink,"#1A1A1A");const TRAIL=toPacked(trailCol,"#5EB8F2");const inkMasks=buildMasks(INK_SETS[glyphs]||INK_SETS.mixed,cell);const trailMasks=buildMasks(TRAIL_SETS[trailShape]||TRAIL_SETS.beads,cell);const inkLevels=inkMasks.length;const trailLevels=trailMasks.length;let cols=0;let rows=0;let W=0;let dark=new Float32Array(0);let field=new Float32Array(0);let next=new Float32Array(0);let imgData=null;let buf=null;let usingImage=false;let time=0;const shape=d=>{let v=(d-.5)*contrast+.5-brightness;if(invert)v=1-v;return clamp01(v);};const sampleProcedural=()=>{const h=Math.max(1,rows*cell);for(let y=0;y<rows;y++){const py=y*cell;for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){const px=x*cell;const d=.4+.14*Math.sin((px+py)*.006+time*.3)+.1*Math.sin((px*.4-py)*.009-time*.2)+.06*Math.sin((px+py*1.3)*.017+time*.25)+py/h*.12;dark[y*cols+x]=shape(d);}}};const sampleImage=()=>{if(!imgEl)return false;try{const off=document.createElement("canvas");off.width=cols;off.height=rows;const octx=off.getContext("2d",{willReadFrequently:true});if(!octx)return false;octx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;octx.imageSmoothingQuality="high";const iw=imgEl.naturalWidth;const ih=imgEl.naturalHeight;const s=Math.max(cols/iw,rows/ih);const dw=iw*s;const dh=ih*s;octx.drawImage(imgEl,(cols-dw)/2,(rows-dh)/2,dw,dh);const px=octx.getImageData(0,0,cols,rows).data;for(let i=0;i<cols*rows;i++){const a=px[i*4+3]/255;const r=px[i*4]*a+255*(1-a);const g=px[i*4+1]*a+255*(1-a);const b=px[i*4+2]*a+255*(1-a);const lum=(.2126*r+.7152*g+.0722*b)/255;dark[i]=shape(1-lum);}return true;}catch{// Cross-origin image without CORS: fall back to gradient
return false;}};const blit=(cx,cy,mask,col)=>{if(!buf)return;let o=cy*cell*W+cx*cell;let m=0;for(let y=0;y<cell;y++){for(let x=0;x<cell;x++){if(mask[m++])buf[o+x]=col;}o+=W;}};const draw=()=>{if(!buf||!imgData)return;buf.fill(BG);for(let y=0;y<rows;y++){const row=(y&mMask)*mSize;const row2=(y+1&mMask)*mSize;const base=y*cols;for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){const i=base+x;const th=matrix[row+(x&mMask)];// Offset lookup so the trail doesn't lock onto the ink pattern
const th2=matrix[row2+(x+half&mMask)];const tl=Math.min(trailLevels,Math.floor(clamp01(field[i])*trailLevels+th2-.25));if(tl>0){blit(x,y,trailMasks[tl-1],TRAIL);continue;}const il=Math.min(inkLevels,Math.floor(dark[i]*inkLevels+th));if(il>0)blit(x,y,inkMasks[il-1],INK);}}ctx.putImageData(imgData,0,0);};const resize=()=>{const w=root.offsetWidth;const h=root.offsetHeight;const nc=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(w/cell));const nr=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(h/cell));if(nc===cols&&nr===rows&&imgData)return;cols=nc;rows=nr;W=cols*cell;canvas.width=W;canvas.height=rows*cell;canvas.style.width=`${W}px`;canvas.style.height=`${rows*cell}px`;dark=new Float32Array(cols*rows);field=new Float32Array(cols*rows);next=new Float32Array(cols*rows);imgData=ctx.createImageData(W,rows*cell);buf=new Uint32Array(imgData.data.buffer);usingImage=sampleImage();if(!usingImage)sampleProcedural();draw();};resize();const ro=new ResizeObserver(resize);ro.observe(root);// Static renderer (editor canvas, export): one frame, no loop
if(isStatic){return()=>ro.disconnect();}// ---------- Pointer ----------
let px=null;let py=null;let qx=null;let qy=null;const onMove=e=>{// Skip finger/stylus input when the trail is hidden on touch
if(e.pointerType!=="mouse"&&!live.current.trail?.touch)return;const rect=root.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=rect.width/(root.offsetWidth||1);const sy=rect.height/(root.offsetHeight||1);qx=(e.clientX-rect.left)/sx/cell;qy=(e.clientY-rect.top)/sy/cell;};const onLeave=()=>{px=py=qx=qy=null;};window.addEventListener("pointermove",onMove,{passive:true});document.addEventListener("pointerleave",onLeave);window.addEventListener("blur",onLeave);const stamp=(x,y,r,strength)=>{const r2=r*r;const x0=Math.max(0,Math.floor(x-r));const x1=Math.min(cols-1,Math.ceil(x+r));const y0=Math.max(0,Math.floor(y-r));const y1=Math.min(rows-1,Math.ceil(y+r));if(x0>x1||y0>y1)return;for(let yy=y0;yy<=y1;yy++){const dy=yy-y;for(let xx=x0;xx<=x1;xx++){const dx=xx-x;const d=(dx*dx+dy*dy)/r2;if(d>=1)continue;const v=strength*(1-d)*(1-d);const i=yy*cols+xx;if(v>field[i])field[i]=v;}}};let raf=0;let last=performance.now();let alive=false;const tick=now=>{raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);const dt=Math.min(.05,(now-last)/1e3);last=now;const t=live.current.trail||{};const radius=Math.max(1,(t.radius??50)/cell);const strength=t.strength??.75;const duration=Math.max(.1,t.duration??1.6);const spread=t.spread??.2;let dirty=false;// Stamp along the path since last frame so fast moves stay continuous
if(qx!==null&&qy!==null){if(px===null||py===null){stamp(qx,qy,radius,strength);}else if(qx!==px||qy!==py){const dx=qx-px;const dy=qy-py;const dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);const steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(dist/(radius*.3)));for(let s=1;s<=steps;s++){stamp(px+dx*s/steps,py+dy*s/steps,radius,strength);}}if(px!==qx||py!==qy){alive=true;dirty=true;}px=qx;py=qy;}// Diffuse + decay
if(alive){const decay=Math.pow(.03,dt/duration);const s=Math.min(1,spread*dt*60*.5);let max=0;for(let y=0;y<rows;y++){const up=y>0?-cols:0;const down=y<rows-1?cols:0;for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){const i=y*cols+x;const c=field[i];const l=x>0?field[i-1]:c;const r=x<cols-1?field[i+1]:c;const avg=(l+r+field[i+up]+field[i+down])*.25;const v=(c+(avg-c)*s)*decay;next[i]=v;if(v>max)max=v;}}const tmp=field;field=next;next=tmp;if(max<.004){field.fill(0);alive=false;}dirty=true;}const sp=live.current.speed??1;if(sp>0&&!usingImage){time+=dt*sp;sampleProcedural();dirty=true;}if(dirty)draw();};raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);return()=>{cancelAnimationFrame(raf);ro.disconnect();window.removeEventListener("pointermove",onMove);document.removeEventListener("pointerleave",onLeave);window.removeEventListener("blur",onLeave);};},[isStatic,imgEl,cellSize,glyphs,pattern,bg,ink,trailCol,trailShape,contrast,brightness,invert,drifting]);return /*#__PURE__*/_jsx("div",{ref:rootRef,style:{width:"100%",height:"100%",position:"relative",overflow:"hidden",backgroundColor:bg,pointerEvents:"none",fontSize:0,lineHeight:0},children:/*#__PURE__*/_jsx("canvas",{ref:canvasRef,style:{position:"absolute",top:0,left:0,display:"block"}})});}GlyphTrail.displayName="Glyph Trail";GlyphTrail.defaultProps={cellSize:10,glyphs:"mixed",colors:{background:"#FFFFFF",ink:"#1A1A1A",trail:"#5EB8F2"},pattern:"8",tone:{contrast:1,brightness:0,invert:false},trail:{radius:50,strength:.75,duration:1.6,spread:.2,shape:"beads",touch:false},speed:1};addPropertyControls(GlyphTrail,{// ---------- Content ----------
image:{type:ControlType.ResponsiveImage,title:"Image",description:"Source image turned into glyphs. Leave empty to use the built-in drifting gradient."},// ---------- Layout ----------
cellSize:{type:ControlType.Number,title:"Cell Size",min:4,max:32,step:1,unit:"px",displayStepper:true,defaultValue:10,description:"Size of each glyph cell. Shapes read best from 8px up."},// ---------- Style ----------
glyphs:{type:ControlType.Enum,title:"Glyphs",options:["mixed","circles","lines","crosses"],optionTitles:["Mixed","Circles","Lines","Crosses"],displaySegmentedControl:true,segmentedControlDirection:"vertical",defaultValue:"mixed",description:"Shape family used for tones. Mixed steps through dot, plus, cross, ring, diamond and square as areas get darker."},colors:{type:ControlType.Object,title:"Colors",buttonTitle:"Palette",description:"Colors of the glyphs and the cursor trail.",controls:{background:{type:ControlType.Color,title:"Background",defaultValue:"#FFFFFF",description:"Color behind the glyphs."},ink:{type:ControlType.Color,title:"Ink",defaultValue:"#1A1A1A",description:"Color of the pattern glyphs."},trail:{type:ControlType.Color,title:"Trail",defaultValue:"#5EB8F2",description:"Color of the glyphs the cursor leaves behind."}}},pattern:{type:ControlType.Enum,title:"Matrix",options:["8","4"],optionTitles:["8\xd78","4\xd74"],displaySegmentedControl:true,defaultValue:"8",description:"How shapes are mixed between tones. 8\xd78 blends smoother, 4\xd74 gives a more repetitive rhythm."},tone:{type:ControlType.Object,title:"Tone",buttonTitle:"Contrast & brightness",description:"Adjusts how dark the source reads before it becomes glyphs.",controls:{contrast:{type:ControlType.Number,title:"Contrast",min:0,max:3,step:.05,defaultValue:1,description:"Pushes tones apart. Higher means harder shapes."},brightness:{type:ControlType.Number,title:"Brightness",min:-1,max:1,step:.05,defaultValue:0,description:"Positive values lighten, negative darken."},invert:{type:ControlType.Boolean,title:"Invert",defaultValue:false,description:"Swaps light and dark areas."}}},// ---------- Behavior ----------
trail:{type:ControlType.Object,title:"Trail",buttonTitle:"Cursor trail",icon:"effect",description:"How the cursor paints and how the paint fades.",controls:{shape:{type:ControlType.Enum,title:"Shape",options:["beads","stars","frames"],optionTitles:["Beads","Stars","Frames"],displaySegmentedControl:true,segmentedControlDirection:"vertical",defaultValue:"beads",description:"Glyphs the trail grows through. Beads go dot to ring to disc, Stars go plus to asterisk, Frames go outline to filled square."},radius:{type:ControlType.Number,title:"Radius",min:10,max:300,step:1,unit:"px",defaultValue:50,description:"Brush size of the trail."},strength:{type:ControlType.Number,title:"Strength",min:.1,max:1.5,step:.05,defaultValue:.75,description:"How bold the trail glyphs get. Lower keeps it subtle, above 1 fills the core."},duration:{type:ControlType.Number,title:"Duration",min:.2,max:10,step:.1,unit:"s",defaultValue:1.6,description:"Roughly how long the trail takes to disappear."},spread:{type:ControlType.Number,title:"Spread",min:0,max:1,step:.05,defaultValue:.2,description:"How much the trail blooms outward as it fades. 0 keeps a crisp line."},touch:{type:ControlType.Boolean,title:"On Touch",enabledTitle:"Show",disabledTitle:"Hide",defaultValue:false,description:"Whether finger drags on phones and tablets paint the trail. Hide keeps mobile static while desktop hover still works."}}},speed:{type:ControlType.Number,title:"Drift",min:0,max:5,step:.1,defaultValue:1,description:"Drift speed of the built-in gradient. 0 keeps it still. No effect when an image is set.\n\nMade by [Justyna](https://justbuilt.it)"}});
